observations.note: Seedlings up in the raised wooden bed: green and red lettuce, kale, chard. Seed packets in the bed for lettuce, spinach, kale, and chard. Bean seedlings in black pots and herb cups (Dill, Sage, Cilantro) on the rack.
Greens sizing up in the raised bed; harvested a bowl of baby greens.
Harvested a bowl of mixed green and red lettuce.
New galvanized oval raised bed planted with young greens and transplants in the front yard.
Tomato plants transplanted into white buckets; cucurbit seedlings in black pots.
Lettuce harvest from the raised bed; a bean plant is climbing at the bed corner.
Basil seedlings in black pots on the rack; cucumbers/squash starting to vine in the raised bed.
Galvanized bed: dense radish greens on one side, rows of beets/chard and a dill plant.
Tomatoes tall and leggy in their buckets; some leaf curl and wilt visible.
Tomato lower leaves browning and drying; cucurbits climbing the string trellis; basil established in the raised bed.
Cucumber/squash vines flowering on the trellis.
